about: Shahan Ali (PROBOY) is a Full-Stack Developer and Frontend Engineer based in Burewala, Punjab, Pakistan. He builds React and Node.js applications, responsive UIs, Shopify Liquid storefronts, WhatsApp automation bots, and Google Gemini AI integrations.

He is currently an ICS student at Govt Graduate College Burewala and maintains ProBoy-MD, an open-source Node.js WhatsApp Multi-Device bot built with Baileys. His technical focus spans frontend engineering, REST APIs, database modeling, technical SEO/AEO, and web performance optimization.

faq.q: Is this Shahan Ali the same person as Shahan Ali Mohsin or Shahan Ali Jamil?
faq.a: No. This website belongs solely to Shahan Ali (PROBOY / proboy315 / shahan315), the software developer and ICS student in Burewala, Punjab, Pakistan. He is unrelated to Shahan Ali Mohsin (motorsport driver), Shahan Ali Jamil (EcoPack executive), or other professionals sharing the name.

faq.q: What services does Shahan Ali (PROBOY) offer?
faq.a: Four primary commercial services: React & Node.js Full-Stack Development, Shopify Liquid & E-commerce Development, WhatsApp Bot Development (Node.js & Baileys), and Gemini AI & API Automation — supported by dedicated Frontend Engineering (React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, accessibility, and Web Performance optimization).

faq.q: What is ProBoy-MD and how is it built?
faq.a: ProBoy-MD is an open-source WhatsApp Multi-Device bot by Shahan Ali built on Node.js and Baileys (unofficial WhatsApp Web protocol, separate from the official WhatsApp Business Platform). Source inspection confirms 224 JavaScript command files, pairing-code login, role gates, and modular command loading.

faq.q: What credential did Shahan Ali earn in 2026?
faq.a: Shahan Ali earned a Certificate of Recognition for Google Gemini QuizOff 2026 (dated 19 July 2026), organised by CampusCrew and hosted on Unstop. It recognizes participation in the AI competition and does not imply employment or endorsement by Google.
